title: Health Education I: Main Exam, 2 April 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM SECTION B

items.text: Define the following terms used in health education:
Explain briefly the objectives of health education and give example of each.
Johari's window is a tool used in communication. Explain FIVE importance of it.
Behaviorism learning theory is commonly used in dental health program. Define this theory and give examples in relation with dental health.
Highlight FIVE reasons why adult learn.
Briefly explain FIVE characteristics of effective health communication.
State and explain FIVE principles of giving effective feedback.
Explain general characteristics of adult learners.
Heath belief model is mostly used in health promotion program. It is one of the key pillar in behaviour change with a well labeled diagram, discuss the health belief model
Mount Kenya University, community oral health students were asked to carry out a dental check-up at Juja primary school, they were asked to use an educational design. Discuss educational design.
Principles of health education are used in carrying out effective health program. Discuss these principles.
